title: Donate or Create? Comparing Data Collection Strategies for Emotion-labeled Multimodal Social Media Posts

bias_targets.methodology: Fitting logistic regression models to test if the post author's gender identity predicts the likelihood of correct emotion classification by multimodal models, identifying differences in accuracy for posts authored by men versus non-men.
Fitting logistic regression models to test if the post author's educational attainment (e.g., advanced degrees vs. no college) predicts the likelihood of correct emotion classification by the models.
Including the post author's age in a logistic regression model to evaluate its effect on the probability of a model correctly classifying the emotion of the post.
Including the post author's ethnicity (European vs. Non-European or multiethnic) in a logistic regression model to evaluate its effect on the probability of correct emotion classification.
